title: Simplify's Michael Green: AI fundamentals have become detached from their stock prices
description: Michael Green, chief market strategist and portfolio manager at Simplify Asset Management, says it is "totally absurd" that investors are putting a multiple on Google's earnings which were boosted by the company's marking up of its position in Anthropic, and that he is also seeing George Soros' theory of Reflexivity playing out. He also discusses the impact of the popularity of levered vehicles on market volatility and what this means for countries like South Korea.
